discovery.title: Cities keep shelling out taxpayer money for sports stadiums, yet the economics almost never makes sense
discovery.summary: Americans are crazy about sports. But whether that passion requires taxpayers to subsidize new facilities every time leagues and franchises ask for them needs rigorous scrutiny.
